title: Performance attribution shows no data while its read is loading or after it failed

real_bff_row_used.label: 青禾｜2330 台股 Paper 學習 R2

delivered: Updated PerformanceAttributionPage in src/management/pages/oversight/PerformanceAttribution.tsx to read loading, refreshing, and error from useV5Live for the performance-attribution query (oversight.performanceAttribution.<dimension>.<period>).

Rendered t('ui.loading') in the table empty state while an attribution read is in flight (isAttributionLoading) and t('errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE') when an attribution read fails (isAttributionError), reserving t('mgmt.pulse.noRows') strictly for completed reads with zero rows.

Updated the focused-persona status banner in src/management/pages/oversight/PerformanceAttribution.tsx to treat an in-flight formal attribution read as loading ((isAttributionLoading || operationsLoading) && !focusResolved) while preserving the existing operations read model and Persona Fleet row fallback behavior.

Added 5 tests in src/management/pages/oversight/PerformanceAttribution.test.tsx exercising the real useV5Live hook with pending/rejected/resolved loaders and the real hosted BFF row (pm12-performance-attribution-persona-persona-be19a1fac471247f2b2a) across en-US and zh-TW, dimension/period filter transitions while in flight, and focused-persona fallback from both Persona Fleet and operationsReadModel.
not_changed: Did not modify backend services, BFF routes, or add any client timeout.
Did not modify locale files; reused existing ui.loading and errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE i18n keys.
Did not weaken, delete, or modify any existing test or assertion.
